rows.label: qst310102_msg0002
rows.name: It wasn't as hard as I expected.

rows.label: qst310102_msg0003
rows.name:
Oh, listen to you!
Just what the boss expected!

rows.label: qst310102_msg0006
rows.name:
Merc Group Action isn't just
about waiting. You carry out
the assignments yourself.

rows.label: qst310102_msg0007
rows.name:
Of course, that also means you
can't do anything else meanwhile.

rows.label: qst310102_msg0008
rows.name:
The results are the same either way,
so pick whichever you prefer, Rex.

rows.label: qst310102_msg0009
rows.name:
And just like with Merc Groups,
the Blades you choose need
the right aptitudes.

rows.label: qst310102_msg0010
rows.name:
All these explanations are
making it sound complicated.

rows.label: qst310102_msg0011
rows.name:
Don't overthink it.
There's no single right answer,
after all.

rows.label: qst310102_msg0012
rows.name:
The important thing is
to try different approaches.

rows.label: qst310102_msg0013
rows.name:
Keep trying things and
you might just get the hang of it.

rows.label: qst310102_msg0014
rows.name:
That's true!
I'll give it a try for now!

rows.label: qst310102_msg0015
rows.name:
That's the spirit!
Keep up the good work
with the Merc Group!
